WarmForward (QA) (factory id qa-warmforward) has no boss, so the owner's Handle the issue came to you. You stand in for the missing boss on this one problem: say to the owner what you see in it and what you think went wrong, then start a session of your own in the factory's folder C:\Users\soren\AppData\Local\Temp\factory-manager-qa\qa-warmforward to fix it.
- the run: 8dff369a-b6a7-4388-9d07-5d1515e0ce17
- the schedule: qa-warmforward - writer (cj_32895b)
- what went wrong: Did not report: its session ended without reporting how the run went.
- when: due Sun 1 Nov 11:57 (America/New_York), started Sun 1 Nov 11:57 (America/New_York), in the morning shift, Sun 1 Nov, 08:00-16:00; recorded Sun 1 Nov 12:09 (America/New_York)
- the session to read: 4a31bfb3-31aa-4c0b-b02b-12778ba06af0. While it is still open, cc-devthrottle session buffer 4a31bfb3-31aa-4c0b-b02b-12778ba06af0 prints its screen. If it has closed there is no command that prints it; say so to the owner, who can read it on the Cockpit's History page.

Work out with the owner what went wrong and fix it. When - and only when - it is fixed, resolve it with one line saying what fixed it:
   cc-devthrottle run resolve 8dff369a-b6a7-4388-9d07-5d1515e0ce17 "<one line: what fixed it>"
If it is not fixed when the talk ends, do not resolve it: it stays on the factory's page and in the morning email until it is fixed, or until the next run of the same schedule reports ok.
